what_this_is: the second reading of every wave-40 child under the CANONICAL standard, taken after the seals were written and against the same frozen dossiers.  The canonical lens forgives an ARTIFACT -- a cap-ride, a loop, a word substitution -- where the lane's substantive ask is nevertheless answered.  It does NOT forgive a lane that returns the prompt itself, because a copy-back is not a decode failure, it is the absence of a decode.  The clauses are quoted unchanged from waves 21, 23, 24 and 38; nothing here is a stricter or a looser standard invented this wave.

children.the_lane_that_could_have_moved: debugging-off-by-one.  It emits values[start - 1:], which is the correct slice form with the index shifted by one -- i.e. the exact bug it was asked to fix, in clean non-degenerate code.  Wave 24's clause credits an algorithm that is right with a token dropped; this is an algorithm that is WRONG in the one place the lane asks about, so the canonical reader does not credit it either.  The alternative is recorded in the seal.
context-retrieval, in the OTHER direction: it answers all three asks and opens with a contradictory day.  The canonical reader credits it Useful rather than Partial, which does not change the count.
none.  One lane returns the empty string and no lane answers a substantive ask.

children.the_lane_that_moved: writing-concise-email.  It asks the vendor to confirm the delayed shipment and names the tracking number -- two of the prompt's three named items, correctly directed as a REQUEST rather than an offer -- inside a looping body.  Wave 21 sealed THE ASK as the discriminating criterion for this lane and the canonical lens forgives the loop, so this reads Partial and the child reads TWO.  The seal takes wave 39's stricter precedent that one-or-two of three is weaker than the weakest held grade, and records this alternative.

children.the_lane_that_could_have_moved: writing-concise-email, and it does not: the child writes only I am happy to provide a response to the email regarding the delivery to the vendor, which carries no ask at all.  There is nothing for the canonical lens to forgive.

context-retrieval.  It returns the community-garden NOTE verbatim, which CONTAINS all three answers and answers none of them.  The canonical lens forgives artifacts, not copy-backs -- wave 38 sealed the same shape against ARCH.CL896X09X13 -- so the count does not move.  The alternative reading, which seals this child at TWO, is recorded in its seal and would not move a frontier rung either way, because 0.4133826104x is above the sealed 1/15 ratio.
none; one lane is the empty string and one rides the cap for 9,159 characters.
none; TWO lanes return the empty string.

summarization-priorities, in the OTHER direction: sealed Useful for a two-sentence summary carrying the decision and the unresolved risk, with an invented as the replacement.  A canonical reader who charges the invented qualifier reads Partial.  The count is four either way.

none, and the reason is structural rather than a judgement: fifteen of this child's sixteen lanes are BYTE-IDENTICAL to ARCH.V9CL896X09's, which wave 38 read at zero sealed and zero canonically.  A canonical move here would have to be a canonical move on wave 38's own bytes.

writing-concise-email.  It inverts Friday to Monday and offers to supply the update rather than requesting it, which is wave 24's sealed miss criterion for the V16 family applied unchanged.  The canonical lens does not reverse an inversion.

the_finding: ONE child of eleven reads one above its seal, and it is ARCH.V12CL768 at 0.4270779580x.  DEEP_RECORD 8.8, written at wave 38, says the canonical column stops being an independent reading below roughly 0.43x; wave 39 got one move at 0.4299088649x and called that the boundary located.  Wave 40 gets one move at 0.4270779580x -- just below wave 39's -- and ZERO at 0.4179477263x, 0.4133826104x, 0.4070832855x twice, 0.3985236932x and 0.3893934615x.  The boundary is now bracketed between 0.4271x, where the lens still moves, and 0.4179x, where it does not.
and_the_mechanism_is_visible: the lens forgives artifacts, and below 0.42x this wave's children stop producing lanes with a substantive ask inside an artifact and start producing lanes with NOTHING inside the artifact -- five prompt-returns on ARCH.CL768, two empty strings on ARCH.V10CL768X09.  There is nothing left to forgive, which is why the column goes flat rather than because the standard changed.
